descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S24 「过渡做法，医院里同一个会话：两个开着的会话保持同步，别处删掉的病人从开着的列表里消失」 Interim, same session in Hospital: two open sessions stay in step, and a patient deleted elsewhere leaves the open list

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 Data syncs between a physician's devices in real time. A pre-round started on one device can be seen and continued on the other without re-entering anything. …（TFA-94513 AC 11；TFA-94513 AC 18） — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Two browser contexts on one account (one storageState), on the Hospital list and chart

When Change the chart in one context and watch the other; delete a patient elsewhere while the list is open

Then The other context shows the change without a reload, and the deleted patient leaves the open list without a reload.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：reactivity.spec.ts assertions, judged against T3 (real-time sync; a delete removes the patient from the other device) as interim evidence only: both contexts share one session and run in Hospital only, so they do not show AC 10's separately signed-in devices or Nursing Home. The two-sign-in, both-modes version is TC-25 S01/S02 (lane C), which owns T3's design.

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。
